messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Heads-up: Helio + RedCloud joint marketplace launch demo at InfraCon next Weds. Need final speaker list, live demo fallbacks, swag drop routing, and marketplace tile ops.
Noah (Marketplace): Marketplace listing needs 1 screenshot + 50-word blurb. Can we get final screenshot by Tue noon?
Esha (Helio Solutions): I'll provide screenshots. Putting together a short 40s walkthrough video.
Tom (RedCloud): Speakers: I can do the 10m overview, Esha does the deep demo. We need a fallback if the demo hits GPU quota.
Priya (Events): Schedule: 20m talk + 30m hands-on pods (remote). Volunteers for pods? Need 3 on-call.
Maya (Partnerships): Volunteers: Maya, Tom, Noah (to triage marketplace questions). Rafael for kit ops.
Rafael (Logistics): Swag plan: carry-on demo kits (150), + 50 attendee promo packs to venue. Shipping PO needed by Mon AM to hit lead time. UPS placeholder: 1ZPALETTE.
Nora (Marketing): Marketing needs headshots & short bios by Mon EOD. Also QR landing page for post-demo NPS.
Esha (Helio Solutions): For demo fallbacks: primary=on-prem pod on Helio cluster, fallback=RedCloud hosted model + recorded demo clip. I'll upload recording to https://gcs.redwood/events/helio-redcloud/clip.mp4
Tom (RedCloud): Quick runbook snippet to swap to fallback (for volunteers):
```
# switch demo to recorded fallback
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.example/switch-demo -d '{"demo":"recorded","id":"helio-rc-1"}'
```
Priya (Events): Run-through Thu 9am PT. Please join. We'll rehearse transitions and opening slide.
Noah (Marketplace): I'll stage the marketplace tile in staging. URL: https://market.staging/tiles/helio-redcloud. Please do not publish until Wed AM.
Maya (Partnerships): Can we include a small quickstart card in the kit with a one-line coupon code? Good conversion.
Rafael (Logistics): Coupon card ok. We need final code by Tue 10am so printing can proceed.
Nora (Marketing): I'll design card. Suggest single-use code HELIO-RC-EXPO. Confirm?
Esha (Helio Solutions): Confirmed. I'll validate coupon in the merchant portal.
Tom (RedCloud): For hands-on pods, volunteers will need the remote SSH key + image. I'll push image: s3://redwood-demo-images/helio-redcloud-2026.img and post sha256.
deploy-bot: Build uploaded -> s3://redwood-demo-images/helio-redcloud-2026.img sha256: d4e5f6a7b8c9.
Tom (RedCloud): Thanks bot. Volunteers: memorize this command to verify image:
`sha256sum helio-redcloud-2026.img | grep d4e5f6a7`
Priya (Events): On-site pickup: Rafael and volunteers at 7:45am. Pod lead call 8:15am. Venue requires name list for security by Tue noon.
Maya (Partnerships): I'll send attendee name list to Priya by Mon.
Rafael (Logistics): Note: if qty drops below 150, notify me Tue AM to adjust manifest.
Nora (Marketing): Post-event: 2-min survey via QR + opt-in for marketplace newsletter. I'll wire the QR and short copy.
Maya (Partnerships): Action items recap: 1) Esha -> screenshots + clip (Tue noon), 2) Noah -> marketplace staging tile (do not publish), 3) Tom -> image + sha (done), 4) Rafael -> PO + labels (Mon AM), 5) Nora -> coupon card + QR (Tue 10am). Run-through Thu 9am PT.
calendar-bot: Invite created -> 'Helio x RedCloud Marketplace Demo - Runthrough' Thu 09:00am PT. RSVP updated.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers ping me direct or drop in this thread. :rocket:
